name: Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots

locations.note: In South America Snake tracks Naomi, Liquid Ocelot's prisoner, to Colombia, where she explains his rapid ageing.
In an Eastern European city Snake finds the resistance led by Big Mama, who turns out to be EVA.
Snake and Big Mama's motorbike escape through the occupied city runs across a recreation of the Charles Bridge.
Snake returns to Shadow Moses for Metal Gear REX's untraceable warhead, and rides REX out against Liquid's RAY.
The epilogue: Snake visits The Boss's grave at Arlington and meets Big Boss.

routes.name: Old Snake
routes.note: Old Snake hunts Liquid Ocelot from South America through an occupied Eastern European city back to Shadow Moses, and ends at The Boss's grave.
